data.description:
## testing_mode: RED

## What
Add test_step18_check_before_verifier() to tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh. Add RED marker to .test-index. This test will FAIL because sprint SKILL.md Step 18 has not been updated yet.

## Test Function to Add
test_step18_check_before_verifier() {
  # Structural ordering / shim-compliance test per behavioral-testing-standard.md Rule 5
  # python3 execution raises ValueError if invariant violated — NOT a grep content assertion
  python3 -c "
c = open('plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md').read()
assert c.index('check-unacked-degradations.sh') < c.index('dso:completion-verifier'), 'check must appear before completion-verifier dispatch'
assert c.index('check-unacked-degradations.sh') < c.index('OPEN_CHILDREN='), 'check must appear before OPEN_CHILDREN= bash block'
  "
}

This test fails because SKILL.md does not yet contain 'check-unacked-degradations.sh'.

## .test-index RED Marker to Add
plugins/dso/scripts/check-unacked-degradations.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh [test_step18_check_before_verifier]

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Test function exists in test file
   Verify: grep -q 'test_step18_check_before_verifier' tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh
2. RED marker added with proper format
   Verify: grep -q 'check-unacked-degradations.sh:tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh \[test_step18_check_before_verifier\]' .test-index
3. The specific new test function currently fails (SKILL.md not updated)
   Verify: bash -c 'source tests/scripts/test-check-unacked-degradations.sh 2>/dev/null; test_step18_check_before_verifier; test $? -ne 0'
data.title: Add failing structural test for sprint SKILL.md Step 18 ordering (test_step18_check_before_verifier)
